title: Corporate Disclosure Query Assistant
business: Financial analysts and compliance officers reviewing large volumes of regulatory filings.
problem: Generic LLMs often struggle to accurately extract or synthesize information from dense, domain-specific financial documents, leading to hallucinations or missed details in critical reports.
solution: The AdaptLLM finance-chat model utilizes continued pre-training on domain-specific corpora, structured as reading comprehension tasks, to improve performance on specialized financial datasets while maintaining conversational capabilities.
steps: Load the pre-trained AdaptLLM finance-chat model using the transformers library.
Initialize the tokenizer associated with the model to handle input text.
Format the user's financial query into the required LLaMA-2-Chat multi-turn conversation structure.
Inject the target financial document as context within the system prompt.
Execute the generation process to retrieve a domain-grounded response.
outcome: Improved accuracy in extracting specific financial data points from complex regulatory filings compared to general-purpose models.
limitation: The model is a 7B parameter research baseline and is not validated for investment decisions. Users should verify outputs against primary source documents to ensure factual accuracy.

diagram.description: The flow of data from raw financial documents to the final user-facing response.

code.content:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
# Load the domain-adapted model
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("AdaptLLM/finance-chat")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("AdaptLLM/finance-chat")
# Apply system prompt and user input in LLaMA-2-Chat format
prompt = f"<s>[INST] <<SYS>> {system_prompt} <</SYS>>\n\n {user_input} [/INST]"
inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt")
outputs = model.generate(input_ids=inputs.input_ids, max_length=4096)
